tagline: Uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid
hero_kpi_rationale: Total Payment Volume (TPV) is the primary driver of Visa's business model: as transactions increase, processing revenues grow. It is a structural master KPI, directly correlated to global adoption of digital payments and e-commerce growth.

kpis.name: Total Payment Volume
kpis.explanation: Total amount of transactions made with Visa cards over one year.
kpis.description: TPV reaches $17,000 billion in 2025, up 11% year-on-year, driven by the expansion of digital payments and e-commerce.
kpis.signal: Strong payment volume growth, a key revenue driver.

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues after deduction of customer incentives.
kpis.description: Net revenues amount to $40.0 billion in 2025, up 11%, supported by transaction volume growth and cross-border activities.
kpis.signal: Revenue growing strongly, aligned with TPV.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin declines to 60.0% in 2025 from 65.7% in 2024, primarily due to a $2.2 billion litigation provision.
kpis.signal: Margin compression due to exceptional provisions.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reaches $20.058 billion in 2025, a slight increase of 2%, as revenue growth partially offsets litigation expenses.
kpis.signal: Net income stable despite exceptional charges.

kpis.name: Share Buybacks
kpis.explanation: Amount spent to repurchase shares on the open market.
kpis.description: Visa repurchased $18.2 billion of shares in 2025 under a $30 billion authorized program.

kpis.name: Transactions Processed
kpis.explanation: Number of transactions processed by Visa in one year.
kpis.description: Visa processed 258 billion transactions in 2025, up 12%, reflecting continued expansion of its global network.
kpis.signal: 258 billion transactions processed, sustained core business growth.

kpis.name: Client Incentives
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to issuers to encourage issuance of Visa cards.
kpis.description: Client incentives amount to approximately $8.8 billion in 2025, up 15%, weighing on operating margin.

kpis.name: AI Technology Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in the acquisition of Featurespace, a specialist in anti-fraud AI.
kpis.description: In December 2024, Visa acquired Featurespace for $946 million, marking a strong commitment to real-time AI technologies for fraud detection.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment in AI to strengthen payment security.

kpis.name: Litigation Provision
kpis.explanation: Amount reserved for interchange fee-related litigation.
kpis.description: Visa recorded a $2.2 billion provision in 2025 for the multidistrict interchange fee litigation, a structural risk of the business model.
kpis.signal: Exceptional charge of $2.2 billion in 2025 related to interchange litigation.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Payment Volume
kpis.explanation: Montant total des transactions effectuées avec des cartes Visa sur un an.
kpis.description: TPV reached $17.0 Tn in 2025, up 11% YoY, driven by digital payments and e-commerce expansion.
kpis.signal: Solid payment volume growth, key revenue driver.

kpis.name: Cross-Border Volume
kpis.explanation: Total Cross-Border Volume +12% cst USD Q2 FY26 (mar 26). Ex-Intra-Europe +11%. Driver direct du Inte
kpis.description: Total Cross-Border Volume +12% constant USD Q2 FY26 (Mar 26). Ex-Intra-Europe +11%. Direct driver of International Transaction Revenue ($3.6 Bn Q2 +10%). Visa canonical KPI, PV=10.

kpis.name: Processed Transactions

kpis.description: Q2 FY26 = 66.086 Bn processed transactions (+9% YoY). TTM 31 Mar 26 = 268.583 Bn (+10%). Key driver of Data Processing Revenue $5.5 Bn (+18%). Secondary hero KPI.

kpis.name: Data Processing Revenue
kpis.explanation: Q2 FY26 Data Processing Rev = $5.5 Mds (+18% YoY). Plus gros segment revenu. Croissance > Service Re
kpis.description: Q2 FY26 Data Processing Revenue = $5.5 Bn (+18% YoY). Largest revenue segment, outpacing Service Revenue ($5.0 Bn +13%) and International Transaction Revenue ($3.6 Bn +10%).
kpis.signal: Largest revenue segment with accelerating growth.

kpis.name: International Transaction Revenue
kpis.explanation: Q2 FY26 = $3.6 Mds (+10%). Driver = cross-border volume ex-intra-Europe +11% cst USD. Marge tres ele
kpis.description: Q2 FY26 = $3.6 Bn (+10%). Driver: cross-border volume ex-Intra-Europe +11% constant USD. Very high margin profile.

kpis.name: Non-GAAP EPS
kpis.explanation: Q2 FY26 Non-GAAP EPS = $3.31 (+20% YoY, +20% cst USD). GAAP EPS $3.14 (+36%). Driver = revenu + buyb
kpis.description: Q2 FY26 Non-GAAP EPS = $3.31 (+20% YoY, +20% constant USD). GAAP EPS $3.14 (+36%). Driven by revenue growth and buybacks. FY26 run-rate ~$12+.
kpis.signal: Strong earnings growth from revenue and capital returns.

kpis.name: Cards in Circulation
kpis.explanation: 5.11 Mds cartes Visa en circulation au 31 dec 2025 (Q2 FY26 op perf data ne reporte pas cards au mar
kpis.description: 5.11 Bn Visa cards in circulation as of 31 Dec 2025 (Q2 FY26 operating performance data does not report cards as of Mar 26). 4.46 Bn accounts. Structural volume driver.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts.
